subject: Intro + demo: confirm roster, windows, and pre-demo asks
messages:
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@apexhealth.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyanka Shah <priyanka.shah@apexhealth.ai>, procurement@apexhealth.ai
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Intro + demo: aligning stakeholders and availability

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the intro yesterday — we're excited to see Redwood in action. We want to schedule a short discovery + demo (45–60 min) to:
- walk through our primary use case (clinical notes ingestion + redaction)
- validate latency/cost expectations for our throughput (avg 750 tokens/session, bursty during business hours)
- confirm security needs (SSO, audit logs, retention)

Attendees we expect on our side: Priyanka Shah (Engineering lead), procurement@apexhealth.ai (procurement coordinator). Security may join depending on what we share.

Capacity windows that work for us next week (ET):
- Tue 2027-08-03: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00
- Wed 2027-08-04: 09:00–11:30

Can you confirm who from Redwood should join (AE, SE, Solutions)? We also have a short pre-demo checklist request: example dataset (sanitized), any demo accounts, and an expected agenda.

Thanks — happy to be flexible.

Alex
Alex Gomez
Product Champion, Apex Health
alex.gomez@apexhealth.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@apexhealth.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, procurement@apexhealth.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 11:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + demo: aligning stakeholders and availability

Alex — great to hear, thanks for the clear context.

We should have AE + SE present. I've looped in Marissa (SE) and Vivek (solutions) to coordinate the technical agenda. Proposed slots from our side (ET):
- Tue 2027-08-03: 11:00–12:00 (45 min)
- Wed 2027-08-04: 10:00–11:00 (60 min)

Marissa, Vivek — can you confirm and flag any technical prerequisites?

Alex — attaching a short pre-demo checklist we use to speed setup (sanitized dataset examples, SSO info, preferred demo tenant). If you can drop the expected attendee list (titles & timezones) and confirm whether security should join, we'll lock the invite.

Attachment: redwood_pre-demo-checklist.pdf (stub)

Next steps:
1) Customer confirms final slot and attendee roster
2) SE & AE prep agenda + pre-demo artifact access
3) Send calendar invite with dial-in and runbook link

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@apexhealth.ai>, Priyanka Shah <priyanka.shah@apexhealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + demo: aligning stakeholders and availability

Thanks Ben. I'm available for both candidate windows, prefer Wed 10:00 ET if procurement is flexible (more overlap with our engineering sync).

Priyanka/Alex — a few quick asks from the SE side so we can target the demo properly:
- expected throughput profile (tokens/sec, concurrent sessions) and any PII constraints
- do you want an embedded demo showing KV cache/latency tradeoffs or a full inference run against a small sample?
- please confirm whether we can share an anonymized sample dataset in advance (S3 link or Drive) and whether we should encrypt it at rest.

I'm including a quick Doodle poll if you want to surface additional times: https://doodle.com/poll/abcd1234-slot-poll
And here's our internal runbook for pre-demo checks (view-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2Bredwood-runbook-demo-prep

If security needs to review data flow, please feel free to add security@apexhealth.ai — we can keep that part to the end of the call.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@apexhealth.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: Priyanka Shah <priyanka.shah@apexhealth.ai>, procurement@apexhealth.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + demo: aligning stakeholders and availability

Ben / team — quick update: procurement just scheduled a mandatory vendor review on Wed 10:00 ET, so the 10:00 slot on Wed conflicts. Can we move to Wed 15:00 ET or Thu 09:30 ET instead? Apologies for the churn.

Attendees confirmed so far: Priyanka (ENG lead), myself, one procurement rep. Security will join if we need to go into retention/audit settings.

Will the 15:00 ET or Thu 09:30 ET options work for you? If not, we can fall back to Tue 11:00.

Thanks,
Alex
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@apexhealth.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, Priyanka Shah <priyanka.shah@apexhealth.ai>, procurement@apexhealth.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + demo: aligning stakeholders and availability

Alex — thanks for the heads up. Wed 15:00 ET works for our team (Marissa confirmed offline). I've added Laura from CS so we can cover procurement and onboarding questions.

Finalized details:
- Date/time: Wed 2027-08-04, 15:00–16:00 ET (60 min)
- Redwood: Ben Carter (AE), Marissa Cole (SE), Vivek Kulkarni (Solutions)
- Apex Health: Alex Gomez (Champion), Priyanka Shah (Eng lead), procurement@apexhealth.ai
- Optional: security@apexhealth.ai if we dive into retention/audit logs

Pre-demo asks (what we need before the call):
- sanitized sample (S3 link or Drive) or a sample redacted text file
- confirm SSO provider (Okta/Google/Azure) if you want SSO demo
- any regulatory constraints to call out (HIPAA, region-specific)

I've sent the calendar invite and attached a stub invite (invitation-APEX-demo.ics). Please accept and feel free to add any additional attendees. We'll send a short agenda + runbook 24 hours before the meeting.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142
